intent.description: 根据网址、活动信息、报名链接和 logo，设计、生成、修改商业宣传海报、活动报名海报、媒体联名邀请海报；支持逐品牌独立构图的批量海报。Create or refine commercial event posters from a URL, brief and brand assets, with considered Chinese/Latin typography, AI-generated visual assets, deterministic QR codes and final-image verification. Use for conference, workshop, launch, exhibition and registration promotion. Excludes academic research posters, slide decks, website implementation, logo creation alone, generic image generation and QR generation alone.
intent.job_to_be_done: Turn URLs, event facts and brand assets into distinct, editable commercial registration posters with verified final QR codes.

should_trigger: 用这个网址设计活动报名海报
给每家媒体做一张宣传海报，融入logo
修改这张海报的标题字距和头像融合
根据课程信息生成招生海报
Create commercial event posters from this URL and logo
Design a launch poster with ticket price and registration code
重排宣传海报，保留时间地点和二维码
near_neighbor: 把海报里的文字翻译成英文

permissions.network: Read user sources; install pinned runtime; use host image tool under existing authorization. Publish/send only when explicitly asked.
permissions.file_write: Requested project outputs and isolated .deps runtime
permissions.subprocess: Local setup, QR, rendering, audit and gallery
permissions.interactive: Only missing critical facts or credentials that truly block work

gates.source: Required facts sourced or supplied; no invented price, date or partnership
gates.visual: Inspect full render, phone view, type and subject edges; repeat after fixes
gates.technical: Zero audit issues, exact QR destination at two sizes, fresh output
gates.delivery: PNG, editable sources, gallery and evidence limits

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
